title: The Greedy Hamster's Stash: Giving Feels Better!

lines.text: Harry the hamster discovered a secret meadow bursting with thousands of sunflower seeds!
lines.caps: Harry the hamster discovered a secret meadow bursting with thousands of *SUNFLOWER | *SEEDS!

lines.text: He stuffed his cheeks until they were round balloons and carted all five hundred seeds home!
lines.caps: He stuffed his cheeks until they were round balloons and carted all five hundred *SEEDS | *HOME!

lines.text: He piled them in his underground vault and locked the door with a sturdy wooden twig!
lines.caps: He piled them in his underground vault and locked the door with a *STURDY | wooden *TWIG!

lines.text: Sitting on a giant mountain of seeds in the dark, his tummy felt full but his heart felt empty!
lines.caps: Sitting on a giant mountain of seeds in the dark, his tummy felt full but his heart felt *EMPTY!

lines.text: Outside, winter winds were blowing cold and his forest friends had very little to eat!
lines.caps: Outside, winter winds were blowing cold and his forest friends had *VERY | little to *EAT!

lines.text: Harry loaded a wooden wheelbarrow and delivered baskets of roasted seeds to every den!
lines.caps: Harry loaded a wooden wheelbarrow and delivered baskets of roasted seeds to *EVERY | *DEN!

lines.text: The forest erupted in cheerful songs, and they invited Harry to a warm winter feast!
lines.caps: The forest erupted in cheerful songs, and they invited Harry to a warm *WINTER | *FEAST!

lines.text: Hoarding things brings worry, but sharing your abundance fills your life with true warmth!
lines.caps: Hoarding things brings worry, but sharing your abundance fills your life with *TRUE | *WARMTH!

lines.text: Give generously and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
